name: select
title: Select
description: A select whose list springs open from the trigger, with a traveling highlight, a drawn check, and a cross-fading value.

useCases: Picking one option from a short or grouped list, such as a region, plan, or sort order, where a native select feels out of place.
limitations: Single selection of string values only. The trigger shows labels from the items prop; without it the raw value is shown. Aligning the selected item over the trigger applies to mouse input and falls back to opening below near viewport edges.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Pass items so the trigger can label the value, and give SelectTrigger an aria-label or aria-labelledby. Reduced motion opens, closes, and moves the highlight instantly.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/select.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
